rule_text.name: 702.229a
rule_text.rule: Coalesce appears on Revelation cards. It represents three static abilities: one that functions while the card is in a player's graveyard and two that function while the card is on the stack. “Coalesce (cost)” means “You may cast this card from your graveyard by paying (cost) rather than paying its mana cost” and “If the coalesce cost was paid, put this card onto the battlefield as a Horror creature. If this spell is a kindred, it also has each of this spell's creature types. If it would leave the battlefield, exile it instead of putting it anywhere else,” and “If the coalesce cost was paid, exile this card instead of putting it anywhere else anytime it would leave the stack except being put onto the battlefield with its coalesce ability.”

rule_text.name: 702.229b
rule_text.rule: A copy of a spell cast for its coalesce cost is unable to enter the battlefield, as a token or otherwise. The spell effect of the copy will still happen as normal.

rule_text.name: 702.229a
rule_text.rule: Coalesce appears on Revelation cards. It represents three static abilities: one that functions while the card is in a player's graveyard and two that function while the card is on the stack. “Coalesce (cost)” means “You may cast this card from your graveyard by paying (cost) rather than paying its mana cost” and “If the coalesce cost was paid, put this card onto the battlefield as a Horror creature. If this spell is a kindred, it also has each of this spell's creature types. If it would leave the battlefield, exile it instead of putting it anywhere else,” and “If the coalesce cost was paid, exile this card instead of putting it anywhere else anytime it would leave the stack except being put onto the battlefield with its coalesce ability.”

rule_text.name: 702.229b
rule_text.rule: A copy of a spell cast for its coalesce cost is unable to enter the battlefield, as a token or otherwise. The spell effect of the copy will still happen as normal.

rule_text.rule: Coalesce

subrules.name: 702.202a
subrules.rule: Coalesce appears on Revelation cards. It represents three static abilities: one that functions while the card is in a player's graveyard and two that function while the card is on the stack. “Coalesce (cost)” means “You may cast this card from your graveyard by paying (cost) rather than paying its mana cost” and “If the coalesce cost was paid, put this card onto the battlefield as a Horror creature. If this spell is a kindred, it also has each of this spell's creature types. If it would leave the battlefield, exile it instead of putting it anywhere else,” and “If the coalesce cost was paid, exile this card instead of putting it anywhere else anytime it would leave the stack except being put onto the battlefield with its coalesce ability.”

subrules.name: 702.202b
subrules.rule: A copy of a spell cast for its coalesce cost is unable to enter the battlefield, as a token or otherwise. The spell effect of the copy will still happen as normal.

rule_text.rule: Coalesce

subrules.name: 702.202a
subrules.rule: Coalesce appears on Revelation cards. It represents three static abilities: one that functions while the card is in a player's graveyard and two that function while the card is on the stack. “Coalesce (cost)” means “You may cast this card from your graveyard by paying (cost) rather than paying its mana cost” and “If the coalesce cost was paid, put this card onto the battlefield as a Horror creature. If this spell is a kindred, it also has each of this spell's creature types. If it would leave the battlefield, exile it instead of putting it anywhere else,” and “If the coalesce cost was paid, exile this card instead of putting it anywhere else anytime it would leave the stack except being put onto the battlefield with its coalesce ability.”

subrules.name: 702.202b
subrules.rule: A copy of a spell cast for its coalesce cost is unable to enter the battlefield, as a token or otherwise. The spell effect of the copy will still happen as normal.
